about: The Postcommunion of the First Sunday of Advent. It asks that we receive God's mercy in the midst of His temple and so go before the coming solemnities of our redemption with fitting honour, taking its opening words from Psalm 47:10 in the Vulgate numbering (Psalm 48 in Hebrew). Its conclusion is printed in the two words Per Dóminum.

s01.translation: May we receive Your mercy, O Lord, in the midst of Your temple, that we may precede the coming solemnities of our restoration with fitting honours. Through the Lord.

w012.function: The future participle agrees with “solémnia” (w013) and presents the solemnities as still to come.

w013.function: The adjective stands substantivally for the coming solemn celebrations of restoration.
